neighbours.label: the piece 'ple' in de|ple|ting and de|ple|tes (the verb 'deplete' in its -ing / -es forms)
fire: Years of intensive farming are depleting the soil of its nutrients.
Chronic stress slowly depletes the body's reserves of energy.
The mining company is depleting the groundwater in the valley.
Each long shift depletes her patience a little more.
Tourism is rapidly depleting the island's supply of fresh water.
A cold winter depletes the fat stores of hibernating bears.
The war was depleting the treasury faster than taxes could fill it.
Running the heater all night depletes the battery by morning.
quiet: Years of intensive farming are exhausting the soil of its nutrients.
Chronic stress slowly drains the body's reserves of energy.
The mining company is polluting the groundwater in the valley.
Each long shift completes another page of her training log.
Tourism is rapidly reducing the island's supply of fresh water.
A cold winter shrinks the fat stores of hibernating bears.
The war was emptying the treasury faster than taxes could fill it.
Running the heater all night flattens the battery by morning.

notes: Card: 'ple' x11 in de|ple|ting/de|ple|tes, weaker ' depletion', ' depleted'. Probes: depleting 0.82, depletes 0.58, depleted 0.06-0.31, deplete 0.16, depletion 0.15; completes 0.05, replete 0.08, exhausting 0.09.
